description: Last real conclusion of every job in every push/pull_request workflow. The object list is discovered by parsing .github/workflows, not enumerated here, because the enforcement surface ledger only classifies scripts/qa/* and would never have looked at boundary-coverage, test, clippy, miri or cross-compile. Verified offline by scripts/qa/ci-liveness.rb in the ci.yml governance job; refreshed from `gh run` locally with --refresh --write.

knownFailing.reason: Run 31565308833 (0d9d09f6) failed exclusively on the liveness gate's own staleness rule: FR-165 edited ci.yml (the governance job gained the rollback-contract and rollback-contract-fixtures steps), which invalidated every record taken at 9f94a892 — the ledger had been stale, and CI on main red for that single reason, since 2026-08-11. Every other aggregated gate in the same run was green, including both new steps (rollback-contract=success, rollback-contract-fixtures=success) and the coverage baseline this FR re-approved (boundary-coverage=success), which was the one outcome DD-181 could not verify locally. This annotation retires automatically at the first refresh after a green governance run on this ledger.

workflows.reason: triggered by v* tags and workflow_dispatch only, so it has no last-run-on-main to assert. A release that fails is visible at the moment someone cuts it, and recording a stale tag build here would say less than nothing.
